column3: Every public function is msg_<kind>(args) -> GameEnvelope: the arguments land verbatim in named fields of a struct literal and nothing else happens. There is no call order, no encoding, and no return value that can mean something other than it says — its own tests are field-echo assertions, which is the shape of an API a signature already explains.
